parameters.query:
-- One Chat Offer per chat. A new one replaces the old under a new id, so the old one's buttons stop working.
INSERT INTO assistant_chat_offers (session_id, kind, details, message_id)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb, $4)
ON CONFLICT (session_id) DO UPDATE SET id = nextval('assistant_chat_offers_id_seq'), kind = EXCLUDED.kind,
  details = EXCLUDED.details, message_id = EXCLUDED.message_id, created_at = now()
RETURNING id, $5::text AS result;
